summary: Tall unanchored furniture and exposed low-level wall sockets present tip-over and child safety risks.

hazards.title: Unanchored Tall Wardrobe
hazards.detail: Tall wardrobe lacks visible wall anchoring and can tip over if climbed or pulled.
fixSteps: Attach heavy-duty anti-tip safety straps to the top rear frame.
Secure the anchor brackets into solid wall studs behind the unit.

hazards.title: Exposed Low Electrical Outlet
hazards.detail: Baseboard electrical outlet is uncovered and accessible to young children.
fixSteps: Insert safety plug protectors into unused wall socket openings.
Install a tamper-resistant outlet cover box for active plugs.

hazards.title: Accessible Drawers Create Ladder
hazards.detail: Lower drawers can be pulled out by a toddler to create a climbing hazard.
fixSteps: Install internal child-safety drawer latches to stop opening.
Teach young children never to pull out or climb on lower drawers.

hazards.title: Low Plug Near High-Traffic Zone
hazards.detail: Unshielded wall socket near the floor poses shock risks if tampered with.
fixSteps: Check faceplate screw tightness and ensure no loose wiring.
Ensure plug pins remain fully covered and guarded against contact.
